description: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Boisée offers a refined blend of woody and floral notes. A subtle interplay of burning wood and iris sets the tone for a fragrance that balances warmth and sophistication. Opening with hints of black pepper and coriander, it leads into a heart of iris and cedarwood, complemented by smooth undertones of cocoa. The base, featuring sandalwood and Indonesian patchouli, leaves a lasting impression of understated elegance—ideal for the modern, confident gentleman.

Restore volume and silkiness while fighting the signs of ageing with Miriam Quevedo’s Platinum and Diamond Luxurious Mask. A unique formulation of diamonds and platinum powder, thermal water, caviar and organic argan oil restore the electrical balance of the hair leaving it soft and healthy looking. Apply a small amount to wet hair and scalp and massage in. Leave on for between five and 15 minutes before rinsing with plenty of water. Use up to three times a week.
A perfect daily shampoo for the whole family! This mild cleanser by Philip B drenches strands in lightweight moisture, protecting colour and taking hair to a whole new level of softness and shine.

Kiehl's Superbly Efficient Anti-Perspirant and Deodorant is a unique formula that's unscented, extremely gentle, yet an efficient cream offering unique skincare benefits. It leaves skin feeling soft, soothed and conditioned with 24-hour protection against sweat and scent, and reduces underarm perspiration utilising advanced micro-sized drying molecules for sheer absorption with no residue.

This treatment Phyto-Lip Shine has more colour than a gloss, and more shimmer than a normal lipstick. The creamy, invisible formula is crafted with mango and kokum butters, which leaves lips hydrated, protected and plumped with a lustful, luminous finish.

The Kiehl's Ultimate Brushless Shaving Cream is enriched with camphor, menthol, sesame seed oil and squalane to provide a smoother shaving experience. Formulated with rich emollients, it ensures optimum moisture levels are maintained throughout leaving skin soft and refreshed.

Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men is an elegant, sensual perfume that perfectly reflects the Dolce & Gabbana man - charismatic and seductive, elegant and sophisticated. The spicy oriental fragrance features fresh top notes of grapefruit, coriander and basil with a warm heart of cardamom and ginger and a deep masculine base of tobacco, ambery notes along with cedarwood.

The select and sensual 212 VIP Eau de Parfum by Carolina Herrera is designed for the modern woman: the life of the party, the socialite and the eternally stylish. Its bold and vibrant personality is heightened with citrus accords that evolve into a musky floral heart, before simmering to a warm vanilla trail that lasts all night long. Reinterpreting freedom and optimism into a delightful sensory experience, the alluring fragrance has a sheer magnetic appeal that’s hard to ignore.

The vegan-friendly Moisture Extreme shampoo from Philip Kingsley has a unique combination of nourishing oils that will make your hair softer, stronger, and easier to style. Oligoquat M delivers a surge of moisture and helps repair damaged hair cuticles. Guar, an anti-static conditioning agent, provides control and smoothness. Sodium Cocoamphoacetate, derived from Cocoa Butter, cleanses, conditions and detangles. It restores moisture and smooths rough cuticles, helping tame even the toughest frizz. Moisture Extreme Enriching Shampoo is also suitable for extremely dry, damaged, or very processed hair.

The Noir Epices Perfume by Frédéric Malle is composed like a Rothko painting, where layer upon layer of somber notes form a deeper, more textured darkness. A thick coating of spices rests on a wooden base of sandalwood and patchouli; while the top notes of orange and geranium are subtly illumined by rose, which, like all masterful paintings, reveal that even darkness is made of light. It makes a perfect evening addition.

Mysterious with a blend of powerful notes, the Oscent Black Eau de Parfum has a oriental scent with a hint of vanilla. The woody heart notes such as white and cedar wood are balanced out by the giner and tobacco, creating a one of a kind parfume that makes an instant statement.

This oil-free Tinted moisturiser from Laura Mercier gives skin a fresh, even finish that won't leave you feeling shiny. Perfect for combination or acne-prone skin, the hydrating oil-free formula contains broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection and SPF 20, line-softening ingredients and antioxidant vitamins C and E. Wear in place of foundation for a healthy, no-makeup look – just layer the buildable formula to give extra coverage where needed.

The Galloway Eau de Parfum by Parfums de Marly stands out for its citrus and peppery notes which are gradually concealed by subtle scents of amber and musk. An intoxicating elixir of strength and sensuality, it envelops the wearer in a cloud of sophistication that is sure to impress.

This extra rich emulsion nourishes the skin with nutrients to leave a supple finish. Ideal for Step 2 of SENSAI's Double Moisturising method, this smooth textured lotion completes the total anti-ageing skincare routine and envelops the skin, saturating it with moisture and beauty ingredients. The skin is balanced with a lasting sensation of deep hydration.

Philip Kingsley's Tricho Pro Volumizing Protein Spray plumps each hair strand to help provide instantly thicker, fuller hair. An easy-to-use, de-tangling blow-dry spray, it is formulated with antioxidants to help moisturise and improve shine, fullness, cuticle integrity and strength, while Organic Quinoa Protein helps strengthen the hair and reduce breakage.

Proving that one pencil can do it all, Sisley Phyto-Eye Twist is the ultimate make up marvel. Boosting a pop of colour, its jumbo tip glides seamlessly on your eyelids, helping you achieve everything from a graphic wing liner to a veil of vibrancy. Supercharged with plant-based active ingredients (we're talking green tea, white lily, camellia and the list goes on), this all-in-one allows for easy application with its firm grip and gliding textures.

Intensive Skin Serum Concealer from Bobbi Brown helps visibly counteract the look of dark circles including aging and excess pigmentation. More than just weightless coverage, this silky hybrid formula treats as it brightens and evens out the skin tone under the eyes for a fresher, brighter, and more rejuvenated look instantly.

Laura Mercier's Velour Lovers Lip Colour offers rich, vibrant color with a matte sateen finish. This long-wearing lipstick is infused with moisturising mango butters, giving it a creamy and velvety feel on the lips despite the chic matte finish.

Aveda's high-performance shampoo for men is designed to leave scalp feeling calmer, healthier, less irritated and less itchy. It's formulated with naturally derived ingredients and features a pure-fume™ fragrance with certified organic spearmint, vetiver, lavender and other pure flower and plant essences.

The Clinique Smart™ SPF 15 Custom Moisturizer targets all major signs of aging while providing sun protection. Using Clinique Smart™ hydration technology, this oil-free formula helps skin attract and retain moisture, visibly improves the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and brightens for a fresh, firm, radiant look.

Open ends, premature hair loss and a lack of vitality are all signs of unhealthy, ageing hair. Miriam Quevedo’s Extreme Caviar Conditioner Balm is formulated with caviar and hydrolyzed keratin peptide to target these symptoms, leaving the hair softer, shinier and healthier after the first application. Apply to wet hair and scalp, massage in gently, and leave on for five to 10 minutes. Rinse thoroughly.

Give your hands the ultimate in softening care with Clarins' Hand & Nail Treatment Cream. The rich emollient formula forms an invisible protective 'glove' that protects hands from the elements, minimising signs of ageing. With regular use, nails are strengthened and cuticles are conditioned for naturally beautiful hands.

With the Velvet fragrance collection, Dolce & Gabbana extend an invitation into their world, infusing the same vibrant, hedonistic heart as Sicily and Italy. With a name inspired by the scent’s pure, green floral quality, the Velvet Pure Eau de Parfum is defined by the Reseda flower, a floral ingredient missing from scents in recent decades. With its unique green crystalline floralcy, it's a homage to the art of traditional perfumery.

The Voulez-vous fragrance from Kilian is inspired by dark nights and games of seduction. This intense scent caresses the skin with notes of neroli and orange blossom, intoxicating Bulgarian rose, radiant white flowers and intense sandalwood. The intoxicating fragrance comes in a glass carafe that is finished with exquisite straight lines and makes a timeless objet d’art.

The Escatin Sheer Voile Lip Colour from Christian Louboutin has a nourishing sensation and radiant colour with a luminous shine. The brand is synonymous with decadence, and so its lip colours are no different: the solid metal body is inspired by Middle Eastern antiquities and the Art Deco movement, and is reminiscent of a precious vial. The turret-like crown cap is topped with a small ring threaded with a silk ribbon, turning the lip colour into a necklace.

A beveled, curved, and pointed sponge brush from By Terry, Pinceau Mousse will help you build an invisible layer of foundation effortlessly and evenly. Whether damp or dry, it is the ideal make-up bag companion for contouring.

Magnetic Blend 1 Eau de Parfum from "The Magnetic Blends" collection by Initio Parfums Privés harnesses the power of pheromones to create fragrances that cast a spell of attraction. Acting like an invisible force that guides your instincts through a sense of smell, it reveals heady notes of amber and musk ambergris creating a distinguished aroma that lingers all day.

Sisley’s Phyto-Touche Sun Glow Powder blends perfectly with the skin and stays in place for flawless, natural and long-lasting make-up. It features a wave design that comprises of two golden beige shades to tailor your tan however you like, and a blush shade to add freshness and radiance. The golden zebra-print compact comes with a mini kabuki brush making it the ideal on-the-go product.

Carolina Herrera’s Burning Rose Eau de Parfum from the coveted Herrera Confidential collection embodies the rich vitality of the colour red. At its heart, luxurious Rose Damascena accords intertwine with opulent Indonesian Patchouli and a mélange of luxurious spices to create a colourfully bold and radiant day-to-night scent.

YSL's Glossy Lip Stain delivers intense glossy colour for an extremely long-lasting shine. The revolutionary lip product combines the sheen of a gloss with the long wear of a stain, and offers a lightweight texture, which immediately melts onto lips.

The Lifting Eye Cream from SENSAI's Cellular Performance range is infused with the brand's signature core ingredient: Koshimaru Silk EX. Taken from the precious Koishimaru cocoon, the source of Japan’s finest silk, this rare ingredient promotes hyaluronic acid synthesis in the dermal and epidermal cells to deliver superb moisturisation. This nourishing cream firms and refines the sensitive eye area skin, revealing a more rejuvenated, youthful appearance.

Prada’s most intellectual and exquisite compositions trigger precise memories.This fragrance evokes the smell of an exotic holiday in the sun; a trip that begins with the sweet warmth of ylang-ylang and davana before revealing a fleshy, floral heart of tuberose and datura, and finishing with sweet frangipani and vanilla.

This rinse-free hand wash from Byredo leaves hands feeling clean without drying them out while delicately scenting them. It's infused with the house's Vetyver fragrance featuring elegant chords of sweet angelica seeds, tart pomelo, delicate florals and rich cashmeran. Apply a single drop onto the hands and spread evenly on both hands for an immediate clean and fresh feel.

Aesop Purifying Facial Exfoliant Paste is a cream-based cleansing formulation enhanced with fine Quartz and Lactic Acid to slough away tired cells and soften the skin. Suitable for most skin types, it is recommended for frequent travellers, during winter and for those living in cool climates.

Kiehl's Deodorant Cream leaves the skin feeling soft, soothed and conditioned with 24–hour protection against sweat and odor. The formula, infused with orange, lemon and linseed extract reduces underarm perspiration utilizing advanced micro–sized drying molecules for sheer absorption. Ideal for all skin types and everyday use, this cream carries the skincare brand's expertise and heritage with its efficiency.

This Balancing Pure-Fume™ Mist from Aveda is an authentic fusion of pure essential oils blended to balance the power chakra, the center of motivation, according to Ayurveda, the ancient healing art of India. Essences of organic lavender, fir balsam and lemon leave one feeling well-balanced and self-confident, with a feeling strong motivation and direction.
Oribe's Silverati Shampoo is specially formulated for grey and white strands. The illuminating shampoo reduces dullness and yellow tones to reveal softer, brighter and more vibrant hair.

Guerlain’s Rouge G line allows more choices than ever before. Named as the first customisable lipstick, the collection offers a a multitude of double-mirror cases, from the most timeless to the trendiest to collect endlessly. Complete with lipstick shades from the range to create a unique make-up essential. Please note that this product is not compatible with the previous Rouge G de Guerlain collection.

Kilian's Moonlight In Heaven Shower Gel is a luxurious formulation that instantly cleanses and refreshes skin. Its signature fragrance opens with vibrant citrus notes sweetened with mango, rice and coconut milk. The scent of this opulent shower gel wraps the wearer in sheer splendour and makes for the first step in their perfuming ritual.

The hydrating Arancia di Capri Lip Balm from the Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo collection has been formulated with shea butter and Vitamin C to protect the lips while it also helps restore their natural moisture. The comforting texture of this lip balm provides a smoothing effect and leaves a relaxing scent on the lips.

The water-like texture of this Lip Stain, glides smoothly over the lips, offering long-lasting, non-transferable color while delivering intense hydration and nourishment. Organic Aloe Vera hydrates, while Organic Raspberry Water softens the lips. The Anti-Pollution Complex protects against environmental aggressors. The brush, infused with the right amount of color, perfectly fits the shape of your lips for a comfortable and precise application.

The cult classic duo from NARS serves up perfectly matched eyeshadow shades with professional-grade pigmentation. Delivering high-impact colour in a single brushstroke, the Alhambra palette pairs shimmering rose gold /shimmering champagne. Presented in a chic slimline compact, the buildable shades can be worn together or alone, and applied wet or dry.

This long-lasting, full-coverage lipstick from Shiseido that stays put for six hours. It features innovative triple gel technology for high-impact, weightless colour. The water infused formula delivers a cooling sensation upon application, while the moisturising ingredients help keep lips feeling soft and hydrated.

Serie Expert Inforcer Leave-In, 150ml is for damaged hair. Smoothing cream infused with vitamin B6 and BiotinInstant reduced breakage action. Instant detangling for stronger hair that is easier to brush

Philip Kingsley's Biotin Boost helps bolster the strength and resilience of the hair with essential components Biotin, Zinc and Vitamin B12. It is ideal for anyone who wishes to optimise the strength of their strands.

Miriam Quevedo’s Glacial White Caviar Resort Leave-In Conditioner delivers a blend of precious oils and botanical extracts to address the specific needs of hair exposed to the elements. Its lightweight formula detangles, eliminates frizz and protects against heat and colour-fading, while advanced biotechnology penetrates the hair fibre with potent antioxidants, proteins, amino acids and peptides to repair, strengthen and protect from the inside out. Its instant barrier function locks in moisture for unprecedented hydration and anti-aging benefits.

The L’Essentiel Natural Glow Foundation by Guerlain is a long-wear liquid foundation with 97% naturally-derived ingredients, blended to deliver buildable coverage and a natural glow finish. The innovative formula is enriched with skincare benefits to hydrate and balance the skin. The silky, smooth texture becomes one with the skin and complexion looks perfected, luminous, and fresh.

Brighten & Perfect 10% Vitamin C Corrective Serum by MZ Skin is a fast-acting, ultra-targeted serum that combines a potent complex of actives and an optimal dosage of 10% stabilised Vitamin C to address the visible effects of UV activated hyperpigmentation, age spots and to reduce skin tone imperfections. It works deeper to help protect elasticity, stimulate collagen synthesis and create a shield to protect against environmental aggressors resulting in a strengthened, refined and brightened skin tone. Use to restore a luminous complexion.

A fresh and romantic flower, the scent of Gardenia is a mainstay in Floral perfumery and yet it gives off so little scented oil that it is rarely - if ever - used in a fragrance. Two years in the making, Gardenia Parfum so perfectly captures the scent of this beloved white bloom, that if smelt side-by-side, no difference would be noted.

Guerlain's Rougeg Lipstick Refill delivers the ultimate luxury of customizable lips. With a blend of black seed oil and intense pigments, the semi-matte formula ensures the perfect balance between hydration and vibrant colour. It is enriched with hyaluronic acid and blurring powders to help smooth and plump up the lips.

Experience the subtle beauty of Gucci's Rouge à Lèvres Voile Sheer Lipstick. This lightweight formula offers a delicate wash of colour with a luminous shine, creating a stunningly natural and radiant look. Infused with ultra-moisturizing properties, this lipstick envelops your lips in a soft, smooth texture that feels incredibly comfortable. Its effortless glide ensures a seamless application, providing sheer and buildable coverage for a personalized finish.

The Essie® Gel Couture line has an array of colours to choose from – varying from fiery reds to midnight blues to elegant nudes. The Touch Up shade from the line is a soft mauve pink that will be a chic choice of colour for everyday workwear. The rich formula effortlessly glides on to nails with a curve-hugging brush for optimal coverage and an ultra-glossy, gel-like finish that lasts for days.

Clarins' Mineral Sun Care Compact UVA/UVB 30 is an antioxidant, high-protection tinted liquid suitable for all types of skin, even the most sensitive. Enriched with fortifying botanical extracts, it protects the skin from damage caused by the sun as well as free radicals, leaving the complexion even, luminous and velvety soft to the touch. It comes in a portable compact with a washable sponge for easy application on the go.

The Rouge Essentiel Silky Créme Lipstick in Mauve Plum by Laura Mercier delivers long-lasting colour with high impact.gliding on with a weightless feel, the lipstick is specially formulated to stay in place for up to six hours without feathering, bleeding or smudging.

The Diptyque Eau Rose Perfumed Brooch is inspired by Renaissance perfume jewellery such as rings and pomanders. It perfumes intensely regardless of where it is pinned. Its secret? A ceramic is slipped behind the brooch to diffuse the intense floral notes and fruity accents of Eau Rose.

Perfumer Philippe Romano's aromatic vision for Berdoues comes to life in the Maasaï Mara Eau de Parfum. A beautiful balanced crafted by contrasting elements of bitter orange, mellow chamomile, warm plum and cinnamon and fresh rose, this fragrance is loved for its luxurious complexity. Thanks to its versatility, Masaaï Mara can be used during any season.

The Pitch and Toss Eau de Parfum is a vibrant scent that rejuventates and lingers elegantly. Sparkling notes of apple and basil are balanced with a heart of rose and cedarwood, finished with rich vanilla and amber. Spritz it to boost the energy level prior to attending evening events.

This Shiseido liquid concealer self-refreshes non-stop with ActiveForce™ technology. This long-wearing, weightless concealer helps resist heat, oil, humidity, and facial movement to maintain coverage that lasts 24 hours. Brighten under-eye fatigue and dullness for an instantly fresher look and immediately diminish the appearance of dark circles, spots, redness and blemishes.

The Even Better Pop™ Lip Colour Foundation range by Clinique uses innovative Shade-Match Science™ to offer flattering, customised lipstick shades designed to complement specific skin tones and undertones. The unique collection offers three perfect shades for individual complexions: Naked, soft neutrals for a barely-there look; Casual, a wash of neutral colour for work or a casual brunch; and Glam, a bold pop of colour for a dramatic look. Enriched with Vitamin E along with nourishing ingredients, this ultra-rich formula moisturises and conditions lips while delivering long-lasting colour for up to eight hours.

Elevate your eye makeup to an exquisite level with Les Phyto-Ombres by Sisley, a collection of mono eyeshadows that redefine radiance, intensity, and seduction. With a palette of nineteen captivating shades, Les Phyto-Ombres offers a world of possibilities for expressing your unique style and enhancing the natural allure of your eyes.

Acqua di Parma's Note di Colonia V pays tribute to the joie de vivre and the light-heartedness of love represented in 'La Donna è Mobile' from the 'Rigoletto' by Giuseppe Verdi. The accents of Pink Pepper mark the cheerful waltz of Lemon and Bergamot, developing into a soaring crescendo that finds its utmost expression in the contrast between the spicy accents of Ginger and the aromatic tones of Juniper. The ambery warm notes of Sandalwood and Cedar complete the harmony of this luminous and vibrant fragrance.

Tom Ford's Beau de Jour fragrance represents the perfectly groomed gentleman who considers every detail. A fresh, commanding entrance of Lavender from Provence introduces the clean and fervent facets of the scent while the core beats with the herbal inflection of African Rosemary and floral green Geranium. Its subtle mint accord creates a powerful contrast to the leather-like warmth of Oakmoss and the electric green of Basil. Patchouli and Amber create an earthy foundation of radiant wood and sensual musky warmth, further elevating Beau de Jour’s refreshing notion of masculinity through the finish.

By Kilian's Flower Of Immortality Eau de Parfum from the Asian Tales collection is a blend of sweet and crisp scents that brings back refreshing spring and summer days. The perfume starts with a fruity splash of nectarine, while the rose, vanilla and fresh freesia add a romantic depth to the scent.

The Spoudrage Parfum by J.U.S. Parfums is an elegant bouquet of florals that's sensual and mesmerising. The powder pink rose and iris waltz together in a sophisticated blend, while complimentary accords dilute the sweetness. It comes in a striking neon-hued flacon and packaging.

Guerlain's Rouge G Lipstick Case from the Stunning Gems collection is inspired by the art of fine jewellery making. The double mirror design allows for easy application and can be customised with adding any lipstick shade from the Rouge G range.

The Tuberóza fragrance from Maison Nishane reveals the captivating tuberose of Mexico which is accompanied by other floral notes like gardenia, marigold and jasmine. A hint of citrus and the strong ambery base further enhances distinctiveness of this elegant scent.

Guerlain's Mad Eyes liquid eyeliner offers a graphic, intense and long-lasting line from the very first stroke of the brush. The exceptionally fine tip, inspired by calligraphy brushes, allows for versatile application while this supple, richly pigmented texture is resistant to water and humidity, ensuring lasting, smudge-free 24-hour wear.

This go-to lip balm by Laura Mercier nourishes and protects lips leaving them conditioned and prepped. Made with cold-pressed Plum Seed Oil for deep nourishment and hydrating Olive-Derived Squalane, the lip balm effortlessly moisturises to maintain the look of fresh, hydrated lips.

SENSAI's eyeliner has an innovative rinseable formula so you get the perfect winged eye every time. Perfect for beginners or those who desire perfection, the easy-to-use liquid liner delivers fluid strokes to achieve any look, from classic bold lines to sleek wing-tips.

Get control of your style with a versatile product that offers a strong hold and a no-shine matt finish. L’Oréal Professionnel Homme Strong Hold Clay has been specifically designed for men to offer style that lasts. This non-sticky formula works great with heat, and leaves no residue.

Versace's Vanille Rouge Eau de Parfum encompasses the Madagascar vanilla, adding a hint of pralines. The sweet tones are accompanied by a powdery musk accord and enriched with an unexpected rose note for an elegant finish.

This hydrating illuminating shampoo for faux-blonde hair gently cleanses the fibre leaving hair light and luminous. This Hyaluronic Acid infused shampoo is a lightweight formula ideal for lightened, bleached, grey or light faux-blonde hair. The gentle cleansing formula soothes and hydrates hair from root to tip, leaving a lightweight feel and illuminating blond tones. It detoxifies hair from pollution and removes dulling agents.

Versatile. Multi-dimensional. Luxe. The Soleil Neige Eye Color Quad creates a smoldering eye touched with an alluring alpenglow effect as pink-toned neutrals and burnished metallics evoke sunset light cast onto snowy mountains. The four complementing shades achieve multiple looks, from a bold, smoky eye, to a subtle, glowing look and everything in between. Formulated with advanced color processes, the luxurious shimmer finish offers a spectrum of intensity and effects that deliver incredible color and outstanding adhesion. two custom applicators included.

Don’t be sh(y)iny by Alkemie is a super normalising cream designed for a complex support of problem skin: prone to acne and inflammations, with large pores, oily and shiny. It contains a loading dose of complementary sebum-regulating, protective and hydrating ingredients.

Armani Beauty's Rouge D'Armani Matte Lipstick offers an intense matte lip colour with absolutely no compromise on comfort. It promises intense coverage in a single application, with a lasting matte finish by containing up to 50% more pigments than a traditional matte lipstick.

Masculine and confident, the new Eros Eau de Parfum by Versace is a fragrance for the bold, passionate man. The sensual scent fuses woody, oriental and fresh notes, creating a powerful perfume that evokes Eros - the god of love. The new fragrance is presented in a blue and gold geometric bottle boasting tactile Medusa and Greca details.

Groom your brows and separate your lashes with Sigma Beauty's Brow & Lash Brush. The classic SigmaTech® fibre spoolie head allows you to fill in and shape your brows using your favourite gel or powder products, while achieving medium to full coverage.

Presenting the Gucci Fluide De Beauté Fini Naturel – both an experiment in expression and a new line of innovative liquid foundations offering controlled coverage results without ever masking natural beauty. Developed to be comfortable, lightweight and completely buildable, this beautifying formula can be adorned as a barely-there finish or for a subtle full-coverage look. Prime with Sérum de Beauté Fluide Soyeux for an enhanced glow effect.

Give your tresses the heady aroma of Exalt Hair Mist by EX NIHILO. An ode to the Asian exquisite sophistication, twisted with the brand's Parisian signature. Top notes of white tea and citrus add a distinct freshness, while a base aroma of rice powder balance them out for a powdery finish.

Say hello to precise and defined eyebrows! This ultra-fine eyebrow pencil by Benefit draws incredibly natural-looking, hair-like strokes that last 12 budge-proof hours. A few strokes of the rich yet blendable colour will transform brows from shapeless and undefined to filled and flawless.

Bobbi Brown's Luxe Defining Lipstick is a fine-tipped lipstick packed with pure power pigment. Designed with the glide of a lipstick but the precision of a pen, its lip-sculpting tip defines and intensifies with all-day, feather-resistant color. The statement-making, creamy matte stays comfortable with a nourishing formula that delivers 12-hour moisture. A built-in sharpener keeps the tip precise. Define. Redesign. Create a luxe, new look.

The M·A·C Powder Blush is designed by and for professionals. It's enriched with vitamin E and formulated to provide fantastic colour to cheeks with ease and consistency. The silky powder applies evenly and adheres lightly to skin to achieve a natural-looking flush of colour.

M·A·C's world-famous alcohol-free Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets and refreshes makeup – making this 4-in-1 mega-multitasker the ultimate overachiever. Part of the Black Cherry collection, this makeup-melding mist gives skin a natural-looking, seamless finish – while keeping makeup looking fresh for up to 12 hours – and is infused with good-for-skin ingredients for lasting benefits. The original bottle is given an elegant update, decorated with beautiful cherry blossoms for the season.

Give the gift of radiant, hydrated, younger-looking skin with Estée Lauder’s revolutionary Advanced Night Repair set. The Advanced Night Repair serum is a deep- and fast-penetrating formula that reduces the look of multiple signs of aging caused by the environmental assaults of modern life, leaving skin smoother and less lined, younger, more radiant and even-toned. The nourishing, Revitalizing Supreme+ Global Anti-Aging Cell Power Creme with Moringa Plant Extract improves skin’s elasticity, helps it feel firmer, and look plumper. Lastly, the supercharged eye treatment helps brighten dark circles and fights the visible impact of lack of sleep, UV, pollution, even blue light, giving you beautiful skin every day.

Marvis Smokers Whitening Mint Toothpaste is specially formulated with stain-resistant polymers to target and reduce the stains associated with smoking, or consuming tea and coffee. The flavour is a sharp taste of cool mint that gives a long-lasting pleasurable taste sensation. The formula helps prevent tooth decay, fights tartar and plaque and keeps breath fresh all day long. It is presented in a metallic tube.

This pressed powder by Bobbi Brown stands up to shine and stays in sync with your skin. The lightweight, breathable formula sets and perfects foundation for a smooth, your-skin-but-better look. The sheer, oil-free and oil-absorbing formula is enriched with Vitamin E to ensure comfortable wear throughout the day, evens out your skin tone and provides all-day shine control for a natural matte finish.

Add a luxurious step to your beauty ritual with this hair mist by Ghawali. Infused with the signature Al Laylaa scent, it's created using a carefully selected formula that protects, softens and tames hair. Delicate notes of Rose, Patchouli and Vanilla leave your hair beautifully scented with a silky-smooth feel.

Milky Mousse Lips by Clarins has a tinted effect that instantly infuses the lips with colour and embraces them with a peach-soft, velvety satin finish. The lightweight, airy and refreshing texture feels like a gentle cloud of whipped cream floating on your lips.

Aqua Resist Smoky Shadow’s remarkably smooth, silky and weightless texture is comfortable on the eyes and easily glides on for a flawless result every time. This vegan, 24-hour multi-use stick provides blendable, creaseless colour and waterproof, sweat-proof and smudge-proof wear. With a built-in sharpener for added precision, you can create any look, anytime, anywhere.

The Lip Lacquer by Tom Ford is a soft matte, transfer-resistant formula for luscious looking lips. It’s masterfully created using pigment-maximising technology that envelops concentrated pigments in rich cushion-like emollients, creating a smooth, secondskin film on lips. Each stroke smoothly paints on intense and saturated mineral powder-infused colour that won’t feather or smudge over the day.

This organic sunscreen lotion by Coola is a coveted classic formulated for your body and designed for long active days in the sun but light enough for everyday use. With its broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection, this antioxidant-rich moisturising lotion has an advanced plant-based oleosome technology that optimises performance, creating a fortified shield that's unbelievably sheer on the skin.

The Cora Essential Set from Thameen features this bright and radiant fragrance in three different forms. The Cora classic Eau de Parfum gives you unrivalled longevity, while the hair fragrance that is enriched with keratin protects, strengthens and scents the hair. The accompanying fragranced body lotion contains argan oil and shea butter and nourishes the skin. Use them together to enjoy a sensorial olfactive experience like no other.

This BôHaras Eau de Parfum by La Manufacture is a sandy breeze that comes knocking on the wooden door of the Selman stud farm. This fragrance is characterised by the burning scent of leather, wood and amber. Nestled in the heart of the most beautiful stable of the Kingdom of Morocco, BôHaras is inspired by this majestic place, full of elegance.

A truly masterful and instantly uplifting tea fragrance, Tea Tonique is inspired by a trip to a tea plantation: early morning mist rolling over rows of neatly planted shrubs, bringing with it a sparkling and refreshing zest from the crisp leaves. Tea Tonique captivates the senses, an infusion of Italian bergamot and floral earl grey, the earthy intensity of maté, and the smoky facets of birch. The cooling spice of nutmeg provides contrast to this delicate and uplifting perfume.

Enhance the look of your skin with NARS’ iconic tinted moisturizer – now available in new shades for all skin types and tones. Its coveted formula smooths on buildable, oil-free coverage infused with SPF30 and packed with skincare ingredients to hydrate, smooth, brighten, and protect. Vitamin C – rich in antioxidants – helps to protect against environmental aggressors and even out skin tone for a brighter-looking complexion in just four weeks.
